items.claim: Ian Garry is in a bigger weight class and has the advantage of being better at range.
items.quote: He's twice his size like you said. He's a bigger weight class. He's better at range.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev can use his wrestling to put Ian Garry on the fence and on his back to grind him down.
items.quote: But I do think that obviously Makhachev can just put him on the fence and grind him there and then put him on his back and grind him there.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has more crafty, creative, and sneaky offensive jiu-jitsu.
items.quote: I think she's got more crafty offensive jiu-jitsu. Like more creative and sneaky.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson forces takedowns and dictates the style of the fight.
items.quote: Gillian Robertson forces takedowns and makes it her style fight. She's been winning because she forces you to fight her style.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern throws a lot harder and has a better chance of getting a knockout than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: I think Dern throws a lot harder and I think she's got a better chance of getting a knockout than Gillian
